binding_gap.reason: The original fragment DXBC has no RDEF chunk, and its shipped fragment metadata is a stale byte-identical copy of the vertex metadata; neither names the b3 buffer. Static evidence therefore proves the character channel-2 producer but not the final channel-2-to-register(b3) binding ABI for HGRP/Lit HGBuffer.
binding_gap.required_evidence: A compatible Unity/HGRP reflection record or an authorized target-frame capture showing the renderer custom-per-draw channel mapped to cb3[0].w.

observed: GBufferPassConstructor builds renderer-list descriptions and submits the HGBuffer renderer list; it does not write b3.
GpuClothManager._SetPerDrawData writes cloth ECS/per-draw data, with no b3 or packed-flag property evidence.
SkinnedMeshCaptureManager uploads BAKE_SKIN_MATRICES_CB through MaterialPropertyBlock.SetConstantBuffer; it is unrelated to the b3 scalar and does not identify cb3[0].w.
The generated ShaderLab has no named material property for cb3[0].w; _ShadingModel is consumed from cb2 and is not the packed flag word.

CustomPerDrawDataChannelUtils and EntityRenderHelperMaterialController provide a source-backed character per-draw producer at channel 2, but its register binding is not named by the available reflection.
producer_audit.conclusion: The source-backed producer for the character custom per-draw channel is recovered (CHARACTER_PARAMS_INDEX=2), while the final channel-2-to-cb3[0].w binding remains open. Do not synthesize a packed word from _ShadingModel, UnityPerDraw, channel 2, or zero/default values. Keep Target2.w and Target3.w neutral until the binding-compatible upload or an authorized target-frame capture is recovered.
